soldier: Soldier head brownish yellow, the anterior end slightly darker, labrum yellow at the centre, mandibles nearly black with reddish brown bases, antennae brownish yellow with the terminal segment nearly yellow, pronotum brownish yellow at the margins, abdomen yellow. Head capsule rectangular, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin narrow and straight, the posterior lateral angles broadly arcuate; in lateral view the head is flattened. Fontanelle minute, an elongate dot, the fontanelle area almost not raised. Eye spot oval and rather large, not bulging. The cover over the antennal socket is bow-shaped and upturned. Labrum nearly circular, the anterior margin bearing 12 long hairs. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apices rather strongly curved. Postmentum enlarged anteriorly, the waist long and narrow, the waist constriction index about 0.44. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 shortest, segment 3 longest and largest, about 2.5 times segment 2 and hammer-shaped. Pronotum kidney-shaped, rather broad, the anterior margin slightly upturned, the V-shaped notch broad and rather deep, the anterior lateral angles narrowly rounded and projecting slightly forward, the posterior margin broadly arcuate, the posterior lateral angles broadly arcuate, the median longitudinal line almost invisible. Hind femur very stout.
